title: Preserve public v1 metadata responses through the Worker

endpoints.before: The Worker could throw while modifying immutable upstream response headers, returning HTTP 500 instead of forwarding the health response.
endpoints.after: The Worker clones the response before applying its existing headers, preserving the upstream health status and streaming body. Public authentication and quota behavior are unchanged.

endpoints.before: The Worker could throw while modifying immutable upstream response headers, returning HTTP 500 and preventing the explorer from loading the deployed contract.
endpoints.after: The Worker clones the response before applying its existing headers, preserving the deployed OpenAPI response status and streaming body. The API contract and routing are unchanged.
